newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cr Lyonnais set for U.S. JV - paper.
newsitem.headline: Cr Lyonnais set for U.S. JV - paper.

text.p: French state-owned bank Credit Lyonnais is expected to announce a joint venture with a U.S. investment bank, Les Echos newspaper said on Thursday.

In a story by its New York correspondent, it said the outgoing head of U.S. operations told the paper the bank should soon announce "joint ventures with a large American investment bank". Robert Cohen is moving to Republic National Bank, it added.

It said Credit Lyonnais U.S. managing director Robert Cohen declined to identify the U.S. bank concerned. Cohen underlined that the troubled Credit Lyonnais bank's U.S. arm had performed very well, with a profit up 40 percent to $211 million in 1996.
